matter_most: A rider who can't be left alone is handed only to a named adult. Nobody there: the driver stays and the owner calls the contact.
Nobody answers at pickup: a safety check first, then the owner decides. Not a no-show first.
The appointment ends at another time: the return moves to the soonest open time, with no fee.
The clinic cancels or the rider goes to the hospital: the return is cancelled, with no fee.
A driver is out: another driver with the same skill and vehicle; a stretcher ride needs two crew, or the owner calls.
The van breaks down: a backup vehicle, or the owner arranges a ride; a rider is never left stranded.
Ice or snow: a ride may move; a ride the rider can't skip is kept if it's safe at all (the owner decides).
A rider becomes ill on the way: 911 first, then the owner and the emergency contact.
In a van, one companion rides along at no charge; more only if seats allow. On the shuttle a companion books their own seat. Service animals always ride; other pets only in a carrier.
